_note: Every number the study uses that is not in data/inputs/. 'basis' is either a citation (DATA_SOURCES.md has the full reference) or the word ASSUMPTION. Change a value here, run scripts/run_all.py, and every result and the README follow.

homes_total.basis: HDB, 'Smart and Sustainable Tengah' (Annex B, June 2024): 'about 42,000 new homes when fully developed'

homes_public.basis: Press reports of HDB's September 2016 master plan announcement (30,000 public, 12,000 private). Secondary source.

persons_per_dwelling.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed (Mar 2025) cl. 3.2.1(a): 'a single dwelling unit shall be taken to house 3.5 persons'

lpcd_public.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(a) Table 4, public housing, litres per capita per day

lpcd_private.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(a) Table 4, private housing, litres per capita per day

peak_factor.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(a) Table 4. Applied to non-residential flow as well: ASSUMPTION

cr_residential_gfa_share.basis: ASSUMPTION: 60% of the gross floor area of 'Commercial & Residential' parcels is housing

return_factor_nonres.basis: ASSUMPTION: share of non-residential water use that reaches the sewer

nonres._note: COPSSW cl. 3.2.1(b) gives no rates for non-residential development ('the proposed design flow together with the basis shall be submitted to PUB for approval'). The rates below are proxies from PUB's published water-use benchmarks; the plot ratios are assumptions wherever the Master Plan gives none.

commercial.rate_basis: PUB Sectoral Water Efficiency Benchmark (published Dec 2025): retail malls, median 1.1 m3/m2/year

industrial_b2.rate_basis: ASSUMPTION: PUB office-building median (1.0 m3/m2/year, published Dec 2025) used as a proxy. Process water and trade effluent are not covered
industrial_b2.plot_ratio_basis: ASSUMPTION: the Master Plan shows 'SDP' (subject to detailed planning) for these parcels

institutional.rate_basis: ASSUMPTION: PUB office-building median used as a proxy for schools, health, civic, sports and worship sites
institutional.plot_ratio_basis: ASSUMPTION: the Master Plan shows 'EVA' (subject to evaluation)

transport.plot_ratio_basis: ASSUMPTION: depot-type sites, low built intensity

manning_n.basis: ASSUMPTION: the COPSSW does not state a roughness value

hydraulics.diameters_basis: ASSUMPTION: a common nominal series. 200 mm is the COPSSW minimum (cl. 3.2.1(d)(i))

depth_ratio_small.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(c)(i): not greater than half the nominal diameter for pipes up to 1.0 m

depth_ratio_large.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(c)(ii): not greater than two-thirds of the nominal diameter for pipes larger than 1.0 m

v_min.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(e)(ii): not less than 0.9 m/s at design peak flow

v_max.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(e)(ii): not more than 2.4 m/s at design peak flow

min_cover_to_soffit_m.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(d)(ii): 'minimum depth of 1.5m below ground level'. Read here as depth to the pipe soffit: ASSUMPTION

manhole_max_spacing_m.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.2(c): distance between manholes not more than 120 m

ground.basis: ASSUMPTION: one ground level for the whole town. No public elevation model of the regraded town was used

v_target_cop.basis: PUB COPSSW 3rd Ed cl. 3.2.1(e)(i): 'Sewers shall be designed to achieve a velocity of approximately 1.5m/s at design peak flow'

v_design_ceiling.basis: ASSUMPTION (design choice of this study): a diameter is accepted when the peak-flow velocity at the depth limit is not above this value. See results/velocity_tradeoff.csv for what 1.0 and 1.5 m/s would do

max_slope.basis: ASSUMPTION: no reach is laid steeper than 1 in 100. Reaches that would need more to reach 0.9 m/s are flagged as not self-cleansing at design peak flow

hydraulics.not_applied: COPSSW cl. 3.2.1(e): 'For small development using the minimum pipe size of 200mm diameter, new sewers should be laid at a minimum grade of 1 in 50 where possible' - not applied; it is written for small developments, and on flat ground it would add 2 m of depth per 100 m

network.outlet_rule: westmost node of the road graph
network.outlet_basis: ASSUMPTION: the real connection point is not public. West was chosen because a DTSS Phase 2 link-sewer contract is named after Old Choa Chu Kang Road / Jalan Bahar (GeBIZ PUB000ETT21000025), west of the town

cost._note: low / central / high. Rates marked Arcadis are from the Arcadis Construction Cost Handbook Singapore 2022, 'Major rates for selected Asian cities', Singapore column, 4th Quarter 2021 prices; they are building-works rates used as proxies for trench works. Everything marked ASSUMPTION is the author's placeholder, not a market rate.

escalation.basis: BCA Tender Price Index (2010=100), BCA free statistics sheet, data as at 21 May 2026. Building-works index applied to civil works: ASSUMPTION. The 2021 annual value stands in for 4Q2021

excavation_per_m3.basis: Arcadis: excavating basement not exceeding 2.00 m deep, S$26/m3

disposal_per_m3.basis: Arcadis: remove excavated materials off site, S$20-26/m3

structural_concrete_per_m3.basis: Arcadis: reinforced concrete grade 30, S$159-165/m3 (concrete only)

rebar_per_kg.basis: Arcadis: high tensile rod reinforcement, S$1.95-2.05/kg

formwork_per_m2.basis: Arcadis: sawn formwork to columns and walls, S$51/m2

shoring_per_m2_face.basis: ASSUMPTION: trench support, per m2 of supported face, both faces

reinstatement_per_m2.basis: ASSUMPTION: road reinstatement over the trench

pipe_k.basis: ASSUMPTION: pipe supply, lay, joint and test, S$/m = k x D_mm x (1 + D_mm/1000)

jack_base_per_m.basis: ASSUMPTION: pipe jacking / microtunnelling, S$/m = base + per_mm x D_mm, pipe included

shaft_base.basis: ASSUMPTION: jacking / receiving shaft with manhole, S$ = (base + per_m x depth) x size factor

bedding_under_pipe_m.basis: ASSUMPTION: thickness of bedding below the pipe. COPSSW cl. 3.2.1(d)(iii) calls for bedding type D of Standard Drawing PUB/WRN/STD/001C, which was not consulted

bedding_haunch_fraction_of_od.basis: ASSUMPTION: bedding carried up a quarter of the outside diameter

excavation_depth_factor.basis: ASSUMPTION: multiplier on the Arcadis rate for trenches deeper than 2 m and 4 m

deep_shoring_from_depth_m.basis: ASSUMPTION: shoring rate doubles below this depth

disposal_share.basis: ASSUMPTION: share of the excavated volume carted off site

max_open_cut_invert_depth_m.basis: ASSUMPTION: reaches whose mean invert depth is greater are costed as pipe jacking

manhole.basis: ASSUMPTION: square reinforced-concrete chamber; internal size by pipe diameter; HDPE lining (COPSSW cl. 3.2.2(d)) at an assumed rate; cover, ladder and benching as a lump sum

preliminaries.basis: ASSUMPTION: preliminaries and traffic management, share of direct works

pes_fee.basis: ASSUMPTION: professional engineering services (design and supervision), share of the construction contract

ac_and_monitoring.basis: Computed at run time from GeBIZ awards (results/gebiz_oncost_ratios.csv): accredited-checker and instrumentation-and-monitoring awards divided by the PUB sewer construction awards they belong to. The matching of awards by title is the author's

programme._note: All durations are ASSUMPTIONS in months. The approval route is from MOF's public statements; the time it takes is not published.

planning_and_consultation_months.basis: ASSUMPTION: scheme planning and in-principle no-objection from HDB, LTA and URA

funding_approval_months.basis: Route: MOF parliamentary reply, 6 Feb 2018 - projects above S$100 million need approval from the Development Planning Committee; projects above S$500 million go through the Gateway Process with the Development Projects Advisory Panel. Durations: ASSUMPTION

detailed_design_months.basis: ASSUMPTION: design, authority clearances, tender documents

construction.basis: ASSUMPTION: production per package, all work fronts together

retention.basis: ASSUMPTION: 5% of the contract held back; half released at completion, half at the end of the defects liability period

commissioning_buffer_months.basis: ASSUMPTION: sewer ready this long before first occupation

outturn_escalation_per_year.basis: ASSUMPTION. For reference, the BCA Tender Price Index rose from 102.8 (2020) to 139.1 (2025)

need_dates._note: ASSUMPTION: month of first occupation that the sewers of each subzone must be ready for. The study plans the whole town from a clean sheet; in reality parts of Tengah are already occupied and sewered.

buildout_years.basis: ASSUMPTION: each subzone fills up in equal yearly steps over this many years from its need date

receiving_sewer._note: ASSUMPTION throughout: nothing about the receiving sewer is public. The table answers 'how big and how empty would it have to be'.

design_velocity_at_limit_depth.basis: ASSUMPTION: the receiving sewer was itself laid to give 1.5 m/s at the COPSSW depth limit

persons_per_dwelling_observed.basis: SingStat table 17863, average household size of resident households

benchmarks.description: PUB, Sewerage Scheme to Serve Pulau Punggol Barat Contract 3 - pumping mains and pipe bridge: DN800 ductile iron, 690 m open cut + 770 m pipe bridge + 680 m pipe jacking
benchmarks.basis: Award value: GeBIZ PUB000ETT21000021 (8 Jul 2021). Lengths: contractor's project page, hsl.com.sg. Pumping main with a bridge, not a gravity sewer

benchmarks.description: LTA sewer diversion contract, two lots: 9.8 km of pipe-jacked sewers, 300 mm to 3.1 m diameter, 112 shafts
benchmarks.basis: The Construction Index, 27 Aug 2015. Trade-press report of the contractor's announcement

eur_to_sgd_2015.basis: ASSUMPTION: round figure for mid-2015, not looked up
